description: Engine setup of map6_s04 (Amusement Park - Cybil boss, Alessa kidnapping), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type APU, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: LarvalStalker, Stalker, GreyChild, Mumbler, MonsterCybil, Dahlia, EndingDahlia, Alessa, Flauros and Parasite). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: smoke_column (a rising smoke column; parameters in the map variables smoke_emitter.*). Here smoke_column is the parasite's blood in Cybil's exorcism. "harry_anim_files" names Harry's keyframe files the map loads over ANIM/HB_M6S04.ANM: the boss fight's ANIM/HBM6_S4B.ANM holds the keyframes of the neck grab, the throw, the floor and the get-up rows (918 and on), which a Monster Cybil spawned on another map loads from it. A mod changes it with its own maps/map6_s04/overlay.json.
